notes: Gold is the union of category vehicle.car only. Other vehicle.* instances are not painted.
Case comes from decide_case, not from the review group. Case other is not scored.
other images stay in img/ and gold/ and are listed under splits.json key unscored. They do not sit in opt, validation, or test.
The scored split is by nuImages logfile (the nNNN-date token before __CAM_). One log is not in two scored splits. held_out is validation + test.
imbalance is actual minus the per-case target. It is a report, not an error. A case with one image stays in one split.
rain_blur and van_truck tags delivered with the review folder are heuristic and unconfirmed.
The converted dataset stays outside git.
